releaseNotes:
CantosTV v1.5.2

- Fixed a crash on Live TV when a channel reconnected/resynced, and when
  reopening the app after leaving it playing in the background.
- Continue Watching now updates the instant you open a channel - every
  channel, every time, even a quick 1-second tune-in.
- Faster, more reliable update prompts when a new version is available.
- Search now opens a movie or series on its own page (with a Play/Resume
  button) instead of jumping to the tab.
